result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to build a dedicated handoff tracker targeting small software teams operating in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Evaluate handoff workflows, coordination frictions, and tracking tooling among small software teams in Latvia.
- Assess workflow integration requirements and willingness to adopt dedicated handoff tracking software.
- Exclude payroll, compensation management, and any financial advice functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Software Team Lead / Technical Operator

Practitioner responsible for coordinating sprint tasks, preparing handoffs, and synchronizing project status between team members.

- How many hours per week does your team spend consolidating and relaying handoff updates between engineers? (question-d7e43c091aa3e459b357af42)
- Which project tracking and communication platforms must a handoff tool integrate with to eliminate copy-paste work? (question-cbb5bc2bafc8e714d462793c)

## Engineering Manager

Decision-maker overseeing team delivery cadence, tooling choices, and departmental budgets in small Latvian software businesses.

- What criteria or budget thresholds determine whether your organization adopts a standalone team coordination tool? (question-edcad2c32ebfcc24ae32b37b)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software engineering teams in Latvia experience recurring manual overhead when consolidating end-of-week handoffs.
- Existing project trackers do not sufficiently automate transition notes between cross-functional or asynchronous team members.
- Teams would prefer an integrated micro-tool over maintaining bespoke spreadsheets or manual summaries.

## Evidence gaps

- No market-wide data exists on typical coordination toolchains used by Latvian software startups.
- Commercial willingness to pay for specialized handoff tracking has not been validated outside synthetic benchmark fixtures.
- The exact technical bottlenecks causing two-hour update copying have not been isolated across multiple teams.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
